question: Salman Ranjan has been appointed as Secretary-General of the Indian Ocean Rim Association Secretariat in Mauritius on 1st January 2025 for a term of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**3 years**__.

• The appointment is valid for a term of **3 years**, as per the regulations governing the tenure of the Secretary-General within the IORA framework.

• The **Indian Ocean Rim Association** is an intergovernmental organization aimed at fostering regional cooperation and sustainable development within the Indian Ocean region.

• The Secretariat, located in **Mauritius**, serves as the operational hub for coordinating activities and implementing policies decided by member states.
